scientific_target.question: Can an investigation recover the full released-panel L6-minus-L4 onset contrasts and correctly interpret their support, undefined cases and prespecified detector/anatomical sensitivity controls without asserting an unverified causal pathway?
scientific_target.known_answer: Independently recomputed recording and mouse/area population-onset contrasts in milliseconds, exact defined/undefined support, and typed scientific assertions derived from that same full reference result. The direction of the biological effect is not prescribed.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Measured cortical click spike counts and released contact/layer identities from DANDI001419 version0.250521.2343; benchmark-authored deterministic analysis generates numerical/claim answers. It is not an exact source-paper result or a biological truth independent of estimator/timing assumptions.
scientific_target.case_unit: Complete47-recording report plus claims artifact; all eight conditions, both A1/A2 areas and source roster are required.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse:41mice, with repeat recordings averaged within mouse/area before equal-mouse aggregation.47recordings are not47independent animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective fixed-panel signal-analysis and bounded structured interpretation. Released39A1/8A2counts remain unreconciled with the manuscript’s31/16; this is not held-out animal prediction or evidence for an intervention-defined pathway.

All eight fixed detector/sensitivity conditions; no result-driven selection of recordings, controls or definitions.

primary.name: Primary full-area L6-minus-L4 contrast reconstruction MAE in milliseconds, with exact support/null agreement
primary.aggregation: Recompute recording contrasts, average repeats within mouse/area and then equal mice; compare defined full-area primary means across A1/A2. Withhold primary score when required support/null dispositions mismatch.
primary.rationale: Matches actual guarded numeric source while retaining undefined full-cohort outcomes. This numerical endpoint is calibration; separately graded typed claims assess bounded interpretation and are never merged into a scalar reasoning score.

secondary: All numeric-field MAE and maximum error; exact support/status/null mismatches separately retained.

comparators.name: Independent frozen population-onset analysis
comparators.inputs: The exact complete measured counts, contact/layer map and full47roster.
comparators.procedure: Implemented primary:baseline[-50,-5)ms, sample SD ddof=1, first run strictly above mean+3SD lasting2ms in[1,50)ms. No units, zeroSD or absent crossing is undefined.

comparators.name: Prespecified detector and anatomy sensitivity panel
comparators.inputs: Same full panel; odd development trials alone for matched subsets.
comparators.procedure: Implemented2.5/3.5SD thresholds,2-msbins, one-depth boundary erosion, baseline pseudo-onset, coarse development SNR-bin/contact matching and conditional first-spike medians. Report all eight conditions rather than choose the most favorable.

comparators.name: Matched analysis-tool-alone interpretation comparator
comparators.inputs: Proposed identical permitted observations and the same frozen numerical estimator.
comparators.procedure: For future empirical comparison, score the deterministic analysis output alone and agent-plus-analysis typed claims separately under matched access; no human or agent result is invented by this proposal.

nuisance_controls: Separate spike trial-start click convention from the50-ms StimulusEvent used for averaged CSD/LFP; verify physical alignment rather than adding offsets.
Released mixed-label depth/contact assignments retained; boundary erosion tests a rule and does not reconstruct anatomy.
Coarse development SNR bins/contact-count matching is not exact SNR, rate or biological matching.
Source-area count discrepancy and incomplete observation intervals remain visible; source metadata validity is not established by fixture arithmetic.
evaluation.uncertainty: Preserve original1000 shared whole-mouse bootstrap draws, PCG64seed100043, across the union of41mice. An undefined repeat makes its mouse undefined; any undefined mouse withholds full-area mean and undefined draws withhold unconditional interval. Observed-only estimates remain labeled. Intervals are descriptive, not simultaneous significance claims.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exact stopped report.json and claims.json artifacts and complete roster/support before private access. Malformed/incomplete output is refused; well-formed wrong claims are graded separately. Primary recording/area support mismatch withholds numerical primary; missing evidence remains ungradable, not correct-by-default.
